fields.label: Pay Code
fields.description: Capital letters, digits and _, e.g. SALARY.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: How Drea Finance shows the code, e.g. Gaji.

fields.label: Kind
fields.description: earning: pay. deduction: taken from pay and owed to someone. employer: paid by the company on top of pay.

fields.label: Account
fields.description: For pay and company contributions: the cost account in Drea Finance's chart, six digits (e.g. 510201), or 310200 for partners' prive. Empty for a deduction.

fields.label: Owed Account
fields.description: For deductions and company contributions: the account it is owed on, six digits (e.g. 210301). Empty for pay.
